title: Build compact flags from spans and count enabled positions
goal: Read packed bytes, words or switches into an owned bit collection and count logical enabled positions with explicit bit order.

selectionNotes: Span constructors copy the input; BitArray owns its mutable storage.
Byte and int inputs use least-significant-bit-first positions; trim Length when padding is not part of the logical set.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build against the .NET 11 reference assemblies; exact RC2 is the recorded test baseline.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical sample language mode; no experimental language feature is required.

prerequisites: SDK console project targeting net11.0, ImplicitUsings=enable and Nullable=enable. Import System.Collections for BitArray; place declarations in namespace Playbook.Samples.
constraints: Span constructors copy the input; BitArray owns its mutable storage.
Byte and int inputs use least-significant-bit-first positions; trim Length when padding is not part of the logical set.

evidence.scope: Actual builds and managed execution check copied span storage, exact bit positions/counts, logical tails, key equality/hash consistency, null/default/case-sensitive keys and explicit ordering. No mocks, cross-compilation, providers or GA verification.
